verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows skills.sh or its featured collection keeping tests or evals that check skill behavior against regressions. The only related item is `skills-ref validate`, which checks a skill against the spec format. That is an adjacent control, not a regression or eval suite, so it earns no credit. Community comments about quality signals concern leaderboard ranking, not testing.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes
